title: Super Boxing Day
description:
BECOME THE CHAMPIONWhen sorority president April Gale gets dumped by her boyfriend, she decides to take a break from men. She organizes a sexy boxing tournament in order to find a woman on campus who is worthy of being her girlfriend. If you can win the tournament and defeat April herself, she will maybe consider having sex with you. But be warned—this is extreme boxing, where losing can have painful, humiliating consequences.

ANOTHER ROUNDSuper Boxing Day is a sequel to Super Grapple Day featuring many of the same characters. But while that game was a turn-based RPG, Super Boxing Day is a real-time arcade-style boxing game, inspired by retro boxing games of the past.

Study your opponents to learn their patterns and punish them when they're least expecting it. If you win, you have the option to show your opponent mercy or to continue to humiliate her in front of the whole crowd.

It's a brutal competition but also a friendly one—and so if you impress your opponent in the ring, it could be the start of an out-of-the-ring romance...

FEATURES*A colorful cast of 7 boxing opponents with unique movesets

*Tactical retro boxing matches

*Vibrant pixel animation

*Interactive minigames to punish—or reward!—opponents
description_short: A foxy boxing simulator, inspired by retro games. Bare it all inside the ring, and you might get lucky afterwards...
